THESE ARE LIVE, NOT PICTURES.

Home: grab the round handle on the track and drag it, or tap any year. Nine stops, 2018 to 2026. The colour of the page changes with the era - teal for healthcare, blue for banking, orange for automotive, violet for the AI years.

Case study: click any of the four stack layers on the left and the panel swaps.

Phone: the same timeline, drag or tap works there too.

TWO THINGS FOR YOU TO CORRECT

1. Dates. I have Express Scripts across 2018-19 and Bank of America in 2020, because your record only pins September 2018 and July 2021. Tell me the real months and I'll fix the stops.

2. Your email is a placeholder in the footer - I won't publish an address without you saying so.

The photo frame in the hero is sized 3:4 for the waterfront shot. Save it to img/kushal.jpg in the repo and I'll drop it in.
